purpose: manual installation benchmark, never application qualification

method.npmCache: isolated, empty on the first install and shared by later repetitions
method.browserCache: new empty directory for each variant and repetition; no CircleCI cache restore

cases: AVD protocol normalizes only the observed name plus optional OK, rejects extra targets/errors
Circle web SDK liveness emits only elapsed time, stops on close/error and leaves disabled sinks unopened
Pods links are fingerprinted with their local targets; foreign links and cycles are refused
Release source and profile fields cannot coerce array/string flags into a valid identity
SDK cleanup proof remains a qualification diagnostic even for a red body
a requested trace is the own non-empty trace page of each passed result
actual SDK passed/exit0 shape cannot hide recording cleanup or secondary error
all routing combinations retain the E2E dependency installs and every campaign shard
archived Release bytes survive a later cache rebuild, partial or existing copies never qualify
artifact bytes/hash and traversal are checked on real files
bounded repetition count and medians have the same cases on every host
campaign refuses modified or undeclared retained evidence files
cancellation reaches the installer and cannot become a successful exit
canonical descriptor refuses duplicate or Debug configuration and preserves explicit native build tools
categorization QA delay activates only for the bounded opt-in persistent mock profile
critical array/boolean and unexpected agent identities are refused
failed installation retains a nonqualifying receipt and prevents browser measurements
finding with no requested or declared media and no artifacts directory is valid
first attempt creates absent parents, collision does not overwrite prior evidence
forced interruption preserves available SDK/log bytes while missing final receipts remain nonqualifying
full and headless installs use the engine browser, even beside another root Playwright
globally passed SDK report refuses every non-passed executed step
headless preparation keeps Linux dependencies, journey typechecks and qualification guards
immutable receipts refuse an already used output
installation diagnostics are independent, SDK still runs, and invalid identity cannot disappear
mismatched matcher and engine versions fail before browser installation
missing app.open, attempt, duplicate result, foreign target/source and stale report fail
nonzero and unknown installer exits stay failures and release signal handlers
only an explicitly opted-in manual/API benchmark runs, for every trigger combination
persistent source/test input mutation fails, declared output changes do not claim source clean
primary exit and SIGINT/SIGTERM survive secondary proof failure
public collection pairs prevent a coherently shortened or wrongly skipped SDK report from passing
read receipts obey the same bounded/profile rules as their canonical build
real Metro cache isolates compiled profiles while retaining identical input reuse
real subprocess success and failure are recorded, with signal and error failures simulated everywhere
requested video missing fails while unchanged report-only bodies remain valid
same-version different binary, changed source/native inputs, nonRelease and wrong profile are refused
skips and excluded IDs are retained separately and never counted passed
spawn errors reject and release signal handlers
spawn uses arguments without shell parsing and preserves other tools browsers
the active pipeline has one setup benchmark and uploads only reports, with no validation or continuation
the former CI coverage fixtures stay unchanged while local commands retain their contracts
union uses target plus test ID and context, separates skip/exclusion and refuses uncovered required IDs
unknown switches and browsers fail before resolving any dependency
web public fixture setup precedes app.open, other UI before it and every native prefix are refused
web report must identify the exact loopback origin and engine

limitations: Local Windows and WSL2 measurements, not a remote CircleCI pipeline duration.
Compare full versus shell within one OS; npm versions and host load differ.
No journey/assertion, native profile, lockfile, backend or publication changed.
The final collector additionally records npmVersion; the timed command and download algorithm are unchanged.
Full release, native/device and remote CircleCI campaigns were not run for this configuration-only change.
